Name: Operating checking
Notes: Tuition, subsidy and food program deposits land here

Name: Tuition receivable
Notes: Optional. Tuition billed but not yet paid if you keep accrual books

Name: Subsidy receivable
Notes: Optional. Subsidy for weeks already provided and submitted but not yet paid

Name: Accounts payable
Notes: Bills not yet paid

Name: Prepaid tuition
Notes: Tuition paid for weeks not yet provided

Name: Enrollment deposits held
Notes: Optional. Refundable deposits held until a child starts or leaves

Name: Payroll liabilities
Notes: Withholdings and employer taxes, from the payroll report

Name: Business credit card
Notes: The payment from checking is a transfer, not an expense

Name: Tuition, private pay
Notes: What parents pay. Record it by family so year-end statements come from the books

Name: Subsidy income
Notes: State child care assistance payments

Name: Food program income
Notes: CACFP reimbursements. Often paid a month after the meals

Name: Registration and other fees
Notes: Enrollment, late pickup, activity fees

Name: Wages
Notes: Teachers, aides, director, from the payroll report

Name: Payroll taxes
Notes: Employer share from the payroll report

Name: Food
Notes: Groceries and meal supplies

Name: Classroom supplies
Notes: Art, learning materials, diapering supplies

Name: Rent
Notes: Home daycares use home expense accounts instead (see README)

Name: Insurance
Notes: Liability insurance

Name: Licensing and training
Notes: License fees, CPR and first aid, required training hours

Name: Merchant fees
Notes: Card and ACH fees
